title: Altman and Nadella on charging for ChatGPT

messages.text: Btw...when do you think you will activate your paid subscription for chatGPT?

we are hoping to be ready by end of jan , but we can be flexible beyond that. the only real reason for rushing it is we are just so out of capacity and delivering a bad user experience. DAUs still growing rapidly
any preference on when we do it?

Let me think about it and weigh in. Overall getting this in place sooner is best. At some level Bing is the scoped ad supported version. So we collectively have both in market on top of the same base model.
sounds good, i agree!

context: Texts between the OpenAI and Microsoft chief executives weeks after ChatGPT launched; one message in the middle of the thread is left out.

title: Altman and Taylor on the temporary board

messages.text: bret, satya, tasha. and adam here. bret and satya and i just texted. we need stability right now for this temporary board configuration and don't think adding someone new we don't know makes sense. tino does sound great and we would be excited to consider him for a future addition.

This is Bret. I don't think we can decide the long term board overnight. The spirt of choosing interim directors is to find folks who can set up the right governance structure and appoint the right board members for the long term . Along those lines, I am personally very comfortable with Will, though I don't know him well. He seems high integrity and obviously knows the organization well. Like Satya, I just want to move forward to stabilize OpenAI. Available to speak any time.

context: Group text with OpenAI board members about who should join an interim board.

title: Korula on AdX's information advantage over header bidding

messages.text: Could you explain the situation a bit more?
The fact that AdX buyers can bid using information that comes out of DFP ranking (EDA price, remnant line items w/ their prices, etc.) is a significant informational advantage.
That reflects in their bidding
Sending callouts before DFP ranking risks losing that
It's a strategic advantage over Header Bidding
Now, competition concerns will cause us to give up one part of that, but that part alone is an 8% decrease to AdX revenue (which we will mitigate through the 1p auction)
But there's no reason to give up the other part, which may even be larger.
Btw, this is also sensitive from a competition perspective, so one should be careful about notes :)
got it.

context: Google chat on a design review for a unified auction; DFP is the publisher ad server and AdX the exchange.
